meta.title: End-to-End Automation for Training Teams | LearnPack
meta.description: Turn any document, video, or idea into a complete interactive course in minutes. AI-powered content generation, real-time analytics, SCORM export, and built-in tutoring.
meta.keywords: training automation, AI course creation, SCORM export, LMS integration, employee training, AI tutor, interactive learning
meta.ogDescription: Create, update, and deliver interactive training from any source material in minutes with AI-powered automation.

hero.title: End-to-end automation for training teams
hero.subtitle: Turn any document, video, or idea into a complete interactive course in minutes. Learners receive contextual guidance with an AI tutor and teachers gain instant creation, updates, and analytics.

definition.text: LearnPack is an AI platform that creates, updates, and delivers interactive training from any source material in minutes. It includes AI-powered content generation, real-time insights, SCORM export, and a built-in tutor for learners.

problems.title: The Problem That Automation Solves
problems.subtitle: Training teams face critical challenges that slow down knowledge delivery

expensive.title: Creating interactive content is slow and expensive
expensive.description: Custom courses cost between $10,000 and $50,000 depending on complexity. Creating a one-hour interactive module requires 184 hours of work.

updates.title: Updating courses adds more burden
updates.description: Modifications require additional instructional design work and increase costs with each revision cycle.

visibility.title: Low visibility into actual learning
visibility.description: Many organizations do not know if employees are understanding content or just clicking through slides.

completion.title: Low completion rates
completion.description: Completion rates typically range between 20 percent and 30 percent for traditional training programs.

support.title: Lack of immediate support
support.description: Employees who receive real-time feedback are twice as likely to complete their training successfully.

features.title: What End-to-End Automation Includes
features.subtitle: A complete system for creating, delivering, and measuring training impact

generation.title: Automated Course Generation
generation.description: Convert any PDF, video, document, or idea into a complete course with readings, quizzes, exercises, and interactive elements.

editing.title: Automated Editing and Iteration
editing.description: Update any block with AI using the Notion-style editor. Simplify, expand, or redo sections with text instructions.

translations.title: Automated Translations
translations.description: Translate content instantly for multiple audiences and languages with a single click.

publishing.title: Automated Publishing
publishing.description: Publish with a unique link, integrate via SCORM, or embed in any LMS with iFrame.

analytics.title: Automated Analytics
analytics.description: Get real-time data on progress, frustration points, and learner engagement.

tutoring.title: Automated Tutoring for Learners
tutoring.description: Rigobot offers contextual help, immediate support, guided questions, multilingual assistance, and continuous availability. Proven to reduce dropout by 50 percent.

howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.subtitle: Three simple steps from idea to published course

step1.title: Describe your topic
step1.description: Answer four questions about the topic, duration, and objectives. You can optionally upload documents.

step2.title: AI builds the complete course
step2.description: LearnPack generates lessons, quizzes, challenges, multimedia, and activities with clear parameters.

step3.title: Refine and publish
step3.description: Talk to Rigobot to add elements, adjust content, translate, or improve clarity. Publish in seconds.
